name: hn
title: Hacker News style community
about: A link and discussion community: submit stories, vote, comment in threads, with a classic look.
features: Installs the hn plugin and the hn-classic theme
Creates the Stories content type, one numbered page per story
Creates every community page, plus a footer menu: Guidelines, FAQ, Lists, API
Adds the header menu: new, past, comments, ask, show, jobs, submit
Optional: News as the homepage and hn-classic as the active theme
Optional: comments on with the community policy for Stories
Ranked comment threads, flags that make comments dead, username and password accounts
Everything is shown on one review screen before you apply it
author: Zen Labs
